sum: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the S&P MidCap 400 (the “underlying index”), which measures the performance of the mid-capitalization sector of the U.S. equity market, as determined by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC (the “index provider” or “SPDJI”). he underlying index consists of securities from a broad range of industries.
